Tuesday Nacho Ride

Lincoln, NE · Social · Gravel

Tuesday Nacho Ride is a social and gravel group ride in Lincoln, NE. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:30 pm from MoPac East trailhead, 84th St & N Hazelwood.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: go your own pace.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday Nacho Ride group ride

Riders take the crushed-limestone MoPac East Trail from the 84th Street trailhead in Lincoln to Eagle, about 10 miles each way. The stop is Bailey's Local in Eagle for nachos. All ages and paces show up, often a hundred or more people. You can also start from Walton or Elmwood for a different distance.
